summary: Brookfield Wealth Solutions Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its Q2 2026 unaudited financial statements and management's discussion. The report covers the period ended June 30, 2026, detailing segments including real estate loans and other private loans, with related-party and non-related-party breakdowns. It includes equity and balance sheet data across Class A exchangeable, Class B, and Class C shares. No special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer, is described. This is a routine periodic financial disclosure by the registrant.
